title: Learning to Plan & Reason for Evaluation with Thinking-LLM-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating response pairs in both possible orders ((a, b) and (b, a)) to measure whether the judge model's preference judgment remains consistent regardless of the order in which the responses are presented.

Evaluating the model on the RM-Bench benchmark to assess its robustness, sensitivity, and resistance to superficial style variations and subtle content differences rather than actual response quality.
